notes: Weaker heal sharing the same heal verb
Baekho's Cunning: stateful multi-tier stance (tier table in verb)
Pestilence: curses-category curse; armor -5 raises effective AC so the victim takes MORE damage (our inverted-AC form of RTK's armor+5); 200s; self-cast legal in a PvP map to block a worse curse
Ju Jak Curse (L99): curses-category; RTK armor+45 -> our -45 (victim takes much more dmg); 6s
Vex: minorcurses (curable by remove_curse AND atone); RTK armor+30 -> -30; ~7min
Death's Face: vex clone (differs only in cast animation)
Scourge: curses-category (curable only by atone, not remove_curse); RTK armor+50 -> -50; ~7min
Dishearten: disheartens-family (own exclusivity slot); RTK armor+6 -> -6; 18s
Venom: DoT MaxHp*1%/1.5s, tick cap 2000, dur 1+rand(3000,30000)ms; mob-only
Spirit's Leech: DoT tick cap 1000, dur 1+rand(1500,30000)ms; mob-only
Bolster: ward, armor +4 (better AC); bolsters family (blocks + blocked by disheartens); 37s
Harden Armor: ward, armor +10; hardarmors family (independent of bolster); 300s; PC or mob
Hoche: protection ward, no stat (occupies the protections slot so curses bounce); self-cast; 60s; 180s cooldown
